items.title: MY MUSICAL ARCHIVE #2 (1986-1989)
items.description: On September 3rd, Concertzender airs part two of the twenty-part series showcasing the complete musical archive of Dutch composer and producer Maarten van der Vleuten (aka The Noise Architect, M.A.W.A. Inc., and many others). This episode features work from 1985 to 1987.

Concertzender is launching a twenty-part series based on my complete musical archive. In this first episode, you’ll hear my very first work as The Noise Architect and M.A.W.A. Inc., covering the period 1985–1989.
